主要内容: On March 17, 2015, Medallion Financial Corp purchased 45,000 shares of common stock at $10.16 per share, totaling $457,184. As of March 17, 2015, $13,662,859 remains available for future stock repurchases under the Current Stock Repurchase Program. On July 29, 2014, the Board of Directors authorized management to repurchase up to $20,000,000 of the Company’s common stock. Since November 2003, the company has repurchased 2,221,876 shares at an average cost of $9.29 per share.
